moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio catalog-ui-button-fill-sweep, written here): Outlined button 140x46, radius 14. At 0.55 s the accent fill wipes from the left edge to the right in 500 ms power2.inOut (clip rect), with a dark copy of the label inside the fill and a 2 px light line on the moving front. At 1.05 s the label changes to 'SELECTED' (slides 8 px right, 0.2 s power2.out) and a check left of it pops (back.out 0.25 s). Fade back 2.3-2.55 s. Params: at · sweep (0.5 s, power2.inOut) · label (SELECT → SELECTED) · check (back.out 0.25 s).
